name: Securities Order
definition: Intention to transfer an ownership of a financial instrument.

OrderEffectiveDate.name: Order Effective Date
OrderEffectiveDate.definition: Date/time on which the order is effective.

OrderExpiryDate.name: Order Expiry Date
OrderExpiryDate.definition: Date/time on which the order is to expire.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique identifier for an order, as assigned by the sell-side. The identifier must be unique within a single trading day.

CashMargin.name: Cash Margin
CashMargin.definition: Identifies whether an order is a margin order or a non-margin order. This is primarily used when sending orders to Japanese exchanges to indicate sell margin or buy to cover. The same tag could be assigned also by buy-side to indicate the intent to sell or buy margin and the sell-side to accept or reject (base on some validation criteria) the margin request.

Side.name: Side
Side.definition: Coded list to specify the side of the order.

SolicitedOrder.name: Solicited Order
SolicitedOrder.definition: Indicates that an order has been generated in response to an advertisement or an indication of interest.

CustomerCapacity.name: Customer Capacity
CustomerCapacity.definition: Capacity of customer placing the order. Primarily used by futures exchanges to indicate the CTI code (customer type indicator) as required by the US CFTC (Commodity Futures Trading Commission).

PositionEffect.name: Position Effect
PositionEffect.definition: Indicates whether the resulting position after a  trade should be an opening position or closing position. Used for omnibus accounting - where accounts are held on a gross basis instead of being netted together.

ForeignExchangeExecutionRequested.name: Foreign Exchange Execution Requested
ForeignExchangeExecutionRequested.definition: Indicates a request for a foreign exchange accommodation trade to be executed along with security transaction.

SettlementCurrency.name: Settlement Currency
SettlementCurrency.definition: Currency to be used for settlement.

OrderOriginatorEligibility.name: Order Originator Eligibility
OrderOriginatorEligibility.definition: Counterparties eligibility as defined by article 24 of the EU MiFID Directive applicable to transactions executed by investment firms for eligible counterparties.

BusinessProcessType.name: Business Process Type
BusinessProcessType.definition: Type of business process model used to carry out the transaction.

OrderedAmount.name: Ordered Amount
OrderedAmount.definition: Cash amount to be used to derive the appropriate quantity of financial instrument to be bought or sold.

GiveUpNumberOfDays.name: Give Up Number Of Days
GiveUpNumberOfDays.definition: Specifies the number of days from trade date that the counterparty on the other side of the trade should be "given up" or divulged.

TradeRegulatoryConditionsType.name: Trade Regulatory Conditions Type
TradeRegulatoryConditionsType.definition: Specifies the regulatory conditions type of the trade.

FundTransactionDirectionIndicator.name: Fund Transaction Direction Indicator
FundTransactionDirectionIndicator.definition: Indicates the type of investment funds transaction.

OrderDate.name: Order Date
OrderDate.definition: Date/time on which the order was placed by the investor with the |trading party.

PegDifference.name: Peg Difference
PegDifference.definition: Price difference for a pegged order.

QuantityType.name: Quantity Type
QuantityType.definition: Describes how the quantity is specified, that is by quantity of units or by amount of money.

ClientOrderIdentification.name: Client Order Identification
ClientOrderIdentification.definition: Unique identifier for the order as assigned by the buy-side.  Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day.  Firms, particularly those  that  electronically submit multi-day orders, trade globally or throughout market close periods, should ensure  uniqueness across days, for example by embedding a date within the ClientOrderIdentification element.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Indicates the type of  instruction to a broker or dealer to buy or sell a financial instrument.

LiquidityProvisionActivity.name: Liquidity Provision Activity
LiquidityProvisionActivity.definition: Indicates whether an order is submitted to a trading venue as part of a market making strategy.||USAGE: when absent, default value is false.

EventType.name: Event Type
EventType.definition: Events affecting the orders in financial instruments.

PegPrice.name: Peg Price
PegPrice.definition: The maximum price at which a pegged order to buy can trade or the minimum price at which a pegged order to sell can trade.

LimitPrice.name: Limit Price
LimitPrice.definition: The maximum price at which a buy order can trade or the minimum price at which a sell order can trade.

OrderedQuantity.name: Ordered Quantity
OrderedQuantity.definition: Quantity of financial instrument to be ordered.

PlaceOfTrade.name: Place Of Trade
PlaceOfTrade.definition: Market at which the order is to be traded.

DayOrderQuantity.name: Day Order Quantity
DayOrderQuantity.definition: For good till orders, the order quantity less all quantity (adjusted for stock splits) that traded on previous days.

SecuritiesOrderPartyRole.name: Securities Order Party Role
SecuritiesOrderPartyRole.definition: Specifies the party which plays a role in the process of ordering securities.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Indicates the status of an order at a specific point in time.

RelatedNegotiation.name: Related Negotiation
RelatedNegotiation.definition: Negotiation which resulted in an order.

Adjustments.name: Adjustments
Adjustments.definition: Charges and commissions associated with a securities order.

LegalParameters.name: Legal Parameters
LegalParameters.definition: Legal parameters required in a securities order for regulatory purposes.

OrderPrice.name: Order Price
OrderPrice.definition: Indicates the requested price for the order. This can be a "stop" price a "limit" price or a "deal" price.

StopPrice.name: Stop Price
StopPrice.definition: Indicates the stop price in case of a stop order or a stop limit order.

SecuritiesOrderAllocation.name: Securities Order Allocation
SecuritiesOrderAllocation.definition: Information about the pre-allocation of an order.

OrderExecutionParameters.name: Order Execution Parameters
OrderExecutionParameters.definition: Conditions under which a securities order must be executed.

OrderingAccount.name: Ordering Account
OrderingAccount.definition: Account impacted by a security transaction.

Quote.name: Quote
Quote.definition: Quote for which the order conditions are specified.

SecuritiesOrderTradingSession.name: Securities Order Trading Session
SecuritiesOrderTradingSession.definition: Details of a specific trading session associated with a securities order.

ListTrading.name: List Trading
ListTrading.definition: List trading information containing a serie of orders.

BuySideRelatedCrossTrade.name: Buy Side Related Cross Trade
BuySideRelatedCrossTrade.definition: Cross trade for which the buy side information is provided.

SellSideRelatedCrossTrade.name: Sell Side Related Cross Trade
SellSideRelatedCrossTrade.definition: Cross trade for which the sell side information is provided.

OrderedSecurity.name: Ordered Security
OrderedSecurity.definition: Security for which an order is specified.

BookingInstructions.name: Booking Instructions
BookingInstructions.definition: Information about the booking of executions.

ExchangeForPhysicalTrade.name: Exchange For Physical Trade
ExchangeForPhysicalTrade.definition: Conditions under which an exchange for physical trade takes place in the case of a non disclosed bid.

ExecutionInstructions.name: Execution Instructions
ExecutionInstructions.definition: Execution instructions in which securities order parameters are defined.
